# artisanvirt_enrollment_token (Resource)

A single-use enrollment token. Pass `value` to the hypervisor agent so it can enroll the host; the node then appears as `discovered` and can be approved with `artisanvirt_node`. The secret is returned only once, at creation, and is stored in state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "artisanvirt_enrollment_token" "rack3" {
  description = "hypervisors in rack 3"
  ttl_minutes = 120
}

# Hand the secret to your host bootstrap (cloud-init, Ansible, ...).
output "enrollment_token" {
  value     = artisanvirt_enrollment_token.rack3.value
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `ttl_minutes` (Number) Lifetime in minutes (max 1440). Defaults to the server setting.

### Read-Only

- `expires_at` (String) Expiry time (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Token id.
- `used_at` (String) When an agent used the token, if it has.
- `used_by_node` (String) Node id that used the token, if any.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) The token secret (`avt_...`) to give to the agent.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import artisanvirt_enrollment_token.rack3 tok-0123456789abcdef  # the secret value cannot be imported
```
